rules: Do not equate a source URL with chapter/paragraph accuracy
All source links are research-only; active provenance pipeline and canonical source registry unchanged
Older sources are historical, not sufficient to establish 2026 disciplinary, scientific or empirical facts
Sedevacantist and SSPX sources prove their original proponent positions, not the assertions within them
Sources sharing the same ecclesial authorship or intellectual tradition are not automatically independent evidentiary corroborations

For medical, safeguarding, and sex-development matters obtain qualified original empirical and clinical evidence, distinguish descriptive science from Church moral positions, and flag outdated assertions
Full paragraph-by-paragraph audit and English/French editorial parity required prior to any answer edit
Do not change live Q&A or add dossiers; this PR is research discovery only
Charles Curran 2018 essay records his current argument and description of earlier dissent, not a verbatim witness for the 1968 group declaration.

A section number must always be tied to the cited edition. For McHugh–Callan the app links to the revised Farrell 1958 digital edition where §1624 is about venereal acts of marriage, whereas the older unabridged Gutenberg edition treats the same subject at §2618 and §1624 concerns foolishness. Never declare an edition-specific citation wrong without checking the actual linked edition.

In high-stakes clinical paragraphs do not equate a theological source with medical treatment evidence. WPATH/APA are actual clinical/professional proponent texts, not substitutes for independent outcome studies. Maintain the distinction between American Psychological Association and American Psychiatric Association.

For survivor trauma, informed consent, and emergency pregnancy: do not infer consent from involuntary physiology, do not give therapeutic procedures as a standalone theological recommendation, and do not delay emergency care for moral debate.
For GOV-09, May 2024 MONEYVAL follow-up is broadly positive with precisely measured technical improvement. Do not present the follow-up as a conviction or proof of generalized Vatican fraud.
For GOV-01, postconciliar responsibility must be dated and layered across legislation, Roman dicasteries, diocesan bishops and local implementation, not reduced to unrelated 2020s diplomatic event.

2024 synod: Francis formally approved the final document and included it in ordinary papal magisterium by his 24 Nov 2024 note, although explicitly not strictly normative. Never describe as only an unapproved consultation or as automatic legislation.

1969 Ottaviani/Bacci: the cardinals signed the forwarding letter; the Short Critical Study was authored by a separate group, with Campo and Guérard historically connected. Do not attribute all document text to cardinals' personal authorship.

APOL-002 source ownership fail: canonical question faith vs reason, previous draft instead evolution/polygenism. Preserve previous evolution four roles in research ledger and link as a case, do not overwrite the APOL faith/reason owner on promotion.

DIL 291 Q&A screened does not imply all are proofread bilingually, source-certified or live; every original question already has locally-declared source identifiers even if supplementary specialist register contains no matching S source.
